name: Ore no Tsure wa Hito de Nashi
original_name: 俺の彼女はヒトでなし
source:
Yuuma attends Hanafusa Academy in the town of Minamihata situated on the peninsula. As the autumn air is starting to get chillier, he continuously sees strange things appearing before him. Trying to escape them, he heads to the school roof and thought things would be fine here. That’s when he looks up and sees his childhood friend Chikae in the night sky… flying on a vacuum cleaner.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/12/11/december-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
Yuuma就读于半岛城镇Minamihata的花房学园。秋意渐浓，天气开始转凉，他却不断看见奇怪事物出现在眼前。为了躲开它们，他来到学校屋顶，以为这里应该不会有问题。就在这时，他抬头望向夜空，看见青梅竹马Chikae…正骑着吸尘器飞行。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/12/11/december-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
